name: Atlantic 10 Cross Country Championships
where: Mechanicsville, VA · host Richmond · Pole Green Park
headline: Atlantic 10 Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Loyola Chicago won both team titles at Pole Green Park. The women scored 69 points to beat Saint Louis (88) and George Washington (91), with Saint Louis' Oliwia Wawrzyniak winning the individual race in 19:37.6. The Loyola men scored 38 to Saint Joseph's 66 and Rhode Island's 86, and Rhode Island's Nick Martin won in 23:30.4 with Loyola's Jake Phillips second in 23:32.4.
